newsitem.title: USA: Ugly Duckling stake held by Kramer Spellman.
newsitem.headline: Ugly Duckling stake held by Kramer Spellman.

text.p: A group led by Kramer Spellman L.P. said Monday it held a 5.08 percent stake in Ugly Duckling Corp or 645,800 common shares.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include a net 280,800 common shares bought between October 15 and December 13 at prices ranging from $13.750 to $17.875 per share.
The group holds the stake for investment purposes, the filing said.
The company operates a chain of used car dealerships in Arizona and targets customers with limited credit histories, low incomes or past credit problems.
